result.summary: Found 3 issues: an untranslated string key exposed in the UI, and minor layout truncation issues with content cut off at the screen edge.

issues.description: Raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' is displayed instead of a translated string, indicating a missing localization entry
issues.suggestion: Add the proper translation string for this key (e.g., 'Popular near you') and ensure the localization pipeline resolves keys before rendering

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge of the screen with truncated text
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or add proper horizontal scroll padding so cards are not abruptly clipped at the screen edge

issues.description: Category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is clipped at the right edge, suggesting an additional category is cut off
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll indicator or fade gradient is present to signal more scrollable content, or add proper padding
